policy.title: Data policy
policy.intro: Summary of how DEexpress Logistics GmbH handles your personal data.

sections.p: DEexpress Logistics GmbH, Lichtenauer Str. 51, 13055 Berlin, Germany. Contact: service@deexpress-logistics.eu.
When you use our contact or quote forms, we collect the details you provide: name, email address, phone number and shipment information. We use this data exclusively to process your inquiry.

Under the GDPR you have the right to access, correct, delete and restrict the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights or if you have questions about data protection, contact us at the address above.
This website does not set marketing cookies and does not use third-party tracking. A language preference may be stored locally in your browser.
